payload.name: Preserve Explicit Descriptions of Possessions and Pets
payload.description: When a user introduces or references a possession, pet, or item and explicitly describes it with adjectives, during extraction.
content: During extraction, if a user gives an explicit descriptive quality of a possession, pet, or item (e.g., 'super cozy and comfy', 'really reliable', 'beautiful'), create a state or preference memory linking that item to the exact description.
Do this even when the statement appears in a photo-sharing phrase or as a follow-up to an earlier mention; do not skip because the item was already known.
Record only adjectives or qualities explicitly stated; do not infer additional attributes, and stop after capturing the description.

solves: Prevents omission of users' explicit qualitative descriptions of their possessions, pets, or items, especially when those descriptions appear in photo-sharing or casual follow-up messages rather than in a dedicated statement.
